title: Klepon
description: Klepon is a dish from Indonesia prepared with sweet rice flour, pandan leaves, desiccated coconut. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Wrap a small piece of palm sugar securely inside each ball of pandan-scented sticky-rice dough; seal completely so sugar does not leak.
Boil the stuffed klepon balls in gently simmering water until they rise and are cooked, then drain and coat in lightly salted coconut.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
